notes: The RTL contains a timeout_enabled generate statement at lines 107-126, but the diagram lists only timeout_counter and timeout_disabled blocks; the timeout_counter process is nevertheless analysed from the RTL.

The CONCEPTS entry C8 describes a fixed build-time timeout as a protection state even though TIMEOUT_VAL is a generic and is not a closed-set element; its effects are reported through timecnt and timeout.
